text: This book starts with a boy who says something no narrator should be able to say. He is a ghost. Then he says he is not a ghost yet. Hold on to both of those. Today you meet Isaac, his family, and his dog Jumper, in the Choctaw Nation in 1830. Keep one question with you: what does Isaac know that you don't?
